answer: Let \(P\) be the transition matrix of a bounded-length random walk on the attestation graph, with voting mass normalized to trusted anchors. If pearl, oasis, and zenith are independent anchors, an adversarial Sybil cluster \(S\) behind a sparse external cut has low conductance \(\Phi(S)\); capped edge influence and min-cut transitivity bounds then limit walk probability entering \(S\), and thus its aggregate voting weight, rather than allowing internal Sybil links to amplify it.
